doubts: No feature matches the Pororari River car park on SH 6 (walkers' end), so W1's end ref is null. Start F4 (unnamed track meets Blackball Road) taken as the Smoke-ho car park at the end of Blackball Road. W2 ends at Waikori Road car park (F2, where the Paparoa Track meets Waikori Road); the page gives it as the mountain bikers' compulsory exit and the section heading offers both car parks as ends, so it may not be meant as a walking option. Neither way's full distance is given except DOC's 55 km (walking); the leg distances '16 km to Pororari River car park, 17.1 km to Waikori Road carpark' cover only the last section. The Pororari River and Waikori Road car parks are also listed under 'accessed by road', so they are recorded as access points (the track can be started from the Punakaiki end) even though they are the ways' ends; the access 'onto' values are my reading of the last section, not stated in Getting there. Croesus Top Hut is passed but cannot be stayed in.
